verdict.rationale: Snyk's docs clearly describe automated fix PRs, actionable fix advice, and newer agentic remediation tools (Remediation Agent, `snyk fix --agentic`) that generate and apply fix plans for vulnerable dependencies. However, hands-on community feedback describes the automated PR feature as low-value and buggy—creating excessive, poorly-targeted PRs, missing version updates, and replacing legitimately forked packages—prompting some users to disable it in favor of Dependabot.
